fonts.display: 'Montreal Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Georgia', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Raspberry Pulse
palette.role: Primary CTA fill, active states, colored shadow accents — the sole saturated hue in the system, creating urgency against matte pastels

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Mint Cream
palette.role: Feature card surface, success-tinted badges, body wash — pastel green for nature/wellness cues

palette.name: Butter Cream
palette.role: Warning-tinted badges, warm section wash, pill highlights

palette.name: Sky Wash
palette.role: Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill

palette.name: Sand Wash
palette.role: Warm neutral section surface, cream card backgrounds

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Dark elevated surface for cards, headers, and contained panels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Muted body text, secondary borders, de-emphasized labels

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Hairline dividers, ghost button borders, list separators

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, ghost button fill

palette.name: Lime Zest
palette.role: Green decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Teal Current
palette.role: Blue decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color
